page_title: App & Website Builder | Build Software in Minutes | Lovable

summary.name: Lovable
summary.one_liner: Lovable is an AI app and website builder where you describe software in plain language and it builds full-stack apps, websites and internal tools.
use_cases: Building a new product from a plain-language description
Creating internal tools for a company
Making a website or landing page
Replacing SaaS subscriptions with custom software
Deploying a full-stack app with hosting and authentication
summary.what_it_does: Lovable lets users describe what they want in plain language and builds production-style software in real time, with iteration on the design before deployment. It covers full-stack apps, websites and internal tools. The page says it handles hosting, SSL, backend infrastructure, authentication and payments, including local payments, currency conversion and tax compliance in 200+ countries and territories. It states it connects to existing tech stacks and includes automatic security scans and audit logs. Projects can be built and managed on web, desktop, and mobile, or from other tools and platforms.
notable: Plain-language description generates full-stack apps and websites
Built-in hosting, SSL, authentication and payments handling
Connects to existing tech stacks without integration code
Automatic security scans and audit logs
caveats: Page mentions 'Start free' but does not list specific plan prices or limits
Most of the page is customer testimonials and metrics rather than technical detail
